title: Mask Values by Interface Style — PAP Therapy Equipment Returns
content:
# Mask Values by Interface Style — PAP Therapy Equipment Returns

**Price card.** When a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit comes back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request, the mask among its used accessories is valued at Summit Ridge self-pay prices according to the interface style recorded on the patient's active **PAP Supply Replenishment Program** enrollment:

| Interface style on the active enrollment | Mask value (USD) |
|---|---|
| full face mask | 129.00 |
| nasal pillows interface (frame and pillow pair) | 108.00 |
| any other style, including a nasal mask | 89.00, the nasal mask value |

**Where the style is read.** The interface style is the mask style recorded on the patient's PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment that is in status active. A patient with no active enrollment has no style recorded there, and the mask is valued at the nasal mask value of 89.00.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- Active enrollment records a full face mask: mask value 129.00.
- Active enrollment records nasal pillows: mask value 108.00.
- Active enrollment records a nasal mask: mask value 89.00.
- Enrollment cancelled, none active: mask value 89.00.
